title: Week 15 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “defined contribution plan”?
options: Protection for eligible deposits up to legal limits through FDIC or NCUA coverage.
A plan for allocating expected income among spending, saving, giving, debt, and goals.
A cost that changes with use, price, or choice.
A retirement account funded by contributions whose future value depends on saving and investment performance.
questions.explanation: Defined contribution plan means a retirement account funded by contributions whose future value depends on saving and investment performance.
